body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics unveiled World''s First 40nm 32Gbit NAND Flash at KES 2006. It differs from conventional products by applying CFC technology with new structure and material (TaN/AlO/Nitride/Oxide/Si). It is expected to release 32GB MP3P which can save up to 8,000 songs with 32Gbit NAND Flash in 2008. Also existing 1.8-inch HDD(Hard Disk Drive) will be replaced by 128GB SSD(Solid State Disk).

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
